summary.text: Bob Long is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 6 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

The district elects three delegates, and he is on the November ballot with fellow Republican incumbents Robin Grammer and Ric Metzgar and Democrats Artus Huffman, Megan Ann Mioduszewski and Rayneika Rob.
A real estate broker and former union truck driver, he serves on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bob Long was born in Baltimore and attended Baltimore County Community College and Essex Community College, according to his legislative biography.
He is a graduate of the Graduate Real Estate Institute, a former union truck driver, and a real estate broker and consultant with Covenant Realty.
Ballotpedia says Long assumed office on January 14, 2015.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Ways and Means Committee.
